objective: Test a validation-only training-median fallback for every frozen ridge arm after the original small-locus study showed overfitting.
development_status: Exploratory follow-up on previously inspected held-out loci; not independent confirmation or encoder selection.
decision_rule: For each target, feature set, fold, seed and context, choose native ridge predictions only if its saved validation MAE is strictly lower than the training-median validation MAE; exact ties choose the median. No refit, no test selection, no clipping.
inputs: Unchanged completed 30-run native ce75c6f study. Replay every original prediction, identity and penalty selection before deriving outputs. Validate the median validation error directly from training/validation labels.
comparisons: All original four T contrasts plus the same contrasts after fallback, and fallback minus original and fallback minus training median for all 14 ridge arms. Error gains are baseline minus full.
inference: Same hierarchical fold/seed bootstrap and exact fold sign-flip/BH within metric across all targets, contexts and contrasts. Spearman retained per run only: constant predictions make correlation undefined.
validity_gates: All 265 loci, 30 runs and original 15 feature arms retained
Source checksums and original prediction replay pass
Save selected arm and unchanged test predictions; no model retraining
limitations: Validation can overfit too; fallback does not guarantee lower test error
Improved probe error does not establish better topology embeddings or genotype calling
All original outcome, donor overlap and graph-version limitations retained
